  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to

philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

About Us

## AKSIGEN Hospital Care is a niche, research driven healthcare company

The company is based in Mumbai, India and has a PAN India presence.

dedicated to putting patients well being first. The Company founded in 1994, was incorporated with a
mission of introducing pathbreaking therapies in the anti-inflammatory space.With this, Aksigen
became the pioneer of the systemic enzyme therapy segment in India- Aksigen was the first Indian
company to launch the safe and effective combination of the Trypsin, Bromelain & Rutoside in India.
The company continued its pathbreaking journey by launching the first and only dispersible
formulation of TBR in the world.

[Read More][11]

## Our Products

### Muscle Cramps

We'll ensure you always get the best results.[Contact Us][12]

[Elastros Pack]

### Elastros Pack

Elastros is a unique combination of Minerals, Vitamins and amino acids that helps patients in
relieving skeletal muscle cramps.

[Read More][13]

## Business Operations

### Domestic

Through its current portfolio of drug therapies, AHC has developed considerable market strengths in
various therapeutic areas such as Orthopaedics, Plastic surgery and General surgery and enjoys good
brand recall from its customer base.

### Manufacturing Information

Our state of Art manufacturing facility complies to WHO GMP standards and is located at MIDC,
Ambarnath. It was set up with a strong commitment to highest ethical standards, quality, safety,
automation and innovation. The facility is dedicated to manufacture tablets and capsule
formulations.

### Overseas

AHC is open to exploring alternative business models including regional contract manufacturing and
technology transfers for expediting availability of its products in select countries.

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

###  
###  
###

and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

carried out during the funding period.

# NIHR Applied Research Collaboration (ARC) West Midlands

The NIHR Applied Research Collaboration (ARC) West Midlands was a seven-year initiative (2019-2026)
with a mission to create lasting and effective partnerships across health and social care
organisations, and universities (Birmingham, Keele and Warwick) in order to improve care services
across the West Midlands.

Our research was carried out across four substantive themes: **Long-term conditions; Acute care
interfaces; Integrated care in youth mental health; Maternity services**, and four cross-cutting
themes that underpin this research: **Organisational sciences; Research methodology, rapid response
and informatics; Public health; Social care**.

About the NIHR

The [National Institute for Health and Care Research][105] (NIHR) funds, enables and delivers
world-leading health and social care research that improves people’s health and wellbeing and
promotes economic growth. The NIHR is funded by the Department of Health and Social Care.

NIHR’s mission is to improve the health and wealth of the nation through research. They achieve this
by:
* Funding high quality, timely research that benefits the NHS, public health and social care.
* Investing in world-class expertise, facilities and a skilled delivery workforce to translate
  discoveries into improved treatments and services.
* Partnering with patients, service users, carers and communities, improving the relevance, quality
  and impact of our research.
* Attracting, training and supporting the best researchers to tackle complex health and social care
  challenges.
* Collaborating with other public funders, charities and industry to help shape a cohesive and
  globally competitive research system.
* Funding applied global health research and training to meet the needs of the poorest people in low
  and middle income countries.

The NIHR infrastructure is detailed in this video: [https://youtu.be/3h0OW8wusBE][106]

About ARCs

[NIHR Applied Research Collaborations][107] (ARCs) support applied health and care research that
responds to, and meets, the needs of local populations, and local health and care systems. There are
15 ARCs across England, part of a £135m investment by the NIHR to improve the health and care of
patients and the public.

Each NIHR ARC is made up of local providers of NHS services, local providers of care services, NHS
commissioners, local authorities, universities, private companies and charities. These
collaborations work together to conduct high quality, generalisable, applied health and care
research that addresses the specific health or care issues in their region.

NIHR ARCs also act to close the second translational gap and increase the rate at which research
findings are implemented into practice.

The 15 ARCs work collaboratively to address national research priorities, with individual ARCs
providing national leadership in their areas of expertise.

A national newsletter is released each month, showcasing news, opinions, events and opportunities
across all 15 ARCs. An archive is [available online][108], and you can [subscribe.][109]

Our Aims

Huge advances have been made in health care over the last century. More recently, it was discovered
that many people do not receive treatments of proven value and that treatments are not always
administered safely. Sometimes, even the basics, such as communication with patients/carers, are
poor. ‘Service delivery research’ helps us understand why people do not receive safe and effective
treatment and tests ways to support frontline staff in delivering the best care. This is the
research we will do in our Centre.

We will make sure that changes made to services are informed by evidence; work with service
providers and the public to design service changes; and evaluate changes by making observations in
the service before, during and after the changes are made.

One major issue we will address is the coordination of care. People often receive care in different
places: GP surgeries, their own homes, care homes, hospitals and community clinics. Patients and
carers have described that care is not joined-up and people delivering care have told us that
coordinating care is a challenge. We will look at ways care can be better integrated to provide
improved outcomes and a better experience for patients. We understand that patients all have
different circumstances and preferences, so we want to develop processes to enable people to make
decisions about their care that are right for them.

Our mission is to create a culture where close collaboration between researchers, the services and
the people who use the services becomes the rule, not the exception. We are committed to ensuring
that in five years’ time the outcome will be better health and a service in which every pound of the
public’s contribution goes on services that use the best evidence of what works. The results we
obtain will be shared around the world so that people everywhere can benefit from what we learn.

Our work builds on research conducted by our predecessors, the NIHR Collaboration for Leadership in
Applied Health Research and Care (CLAHRC) for West Midlands, and the CLAHRC Birmingham and Black
Country pilot.

A national newsletter is released each month, showcasing news, opinions, events and opportunities
across all 15 ARCs. An archive is [available online][108], and you can [subscribe.][109]

Our Aims

Huge advances have been made in health care over the last century. More recently, it was discovered
that many people do not receive treatments of proven value and that treatments are not always
administered safely. Sometimes, even the basics, such as communication with patients/carers, are
poor. ‘Service delivery research’ helps us understand why people do not receive safe and effective
treatment and tests ways to support frontline staff in delivering the best care. This is the
research we will do in our Centre.

We will make sure that changes made to services are informed by evidence; work with service
providers and the public to design service changes; and evaluate changes by making observations in
the service before, during and after the changes are made.

One major issue we will address is the coordination of care. People often receive care in different
places: GP surgeries, their own homes, care homes, hospitals and community clinics. Patients and
carers have described that care is not joined-up and people delivering care have told us that
coordinating care is a challenge. We will look at ways care can be better integrated to provide
improved outcomes and a better experience for patients. We understand that patients all have
different circumstances and preferences, so we want to develop processes to enable people to make
decisions about their care that are right for them.

Our mission is to create a culture where close collaboration between researchers, the services and
the people who use the services becomes the rule, not the exception. We are committed to ensuring
that in five years’ time the outcome will be better health and a service in which every pound of the
public’s contribution goes on services that use the best evidence of what works. The results we
obtain will be shared around the world so that people everywhere can benefit from what we learn.

Our work builds on research conducted by our predecessors, the NIHR Collaboration for Leadership in
Applied Health Research and Care (CLAHRC) for West Midlands, and the CLAHRC Birmingham and Black
Country pilot.

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do

# Catalyzing Transformative Innovations in Health & Healthcare

The mission of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation (DIHI) is to catalyze transformative
innovations in health and healthcare, and to help cultivate a community of innovation and
entrepreneurship across Duke University and the health enterprise.

[ Learn More About Us ][38]

## Annual Request for Applications

In alignment with the its mission, the Duke Institute for Health Innovation is constantly seeking
out innovations in care delivery. The annual request for applications (RFA) is a mechanism for
designing and implementing innovations to address actual and important problems encountered by care
providers, patients and their loved ones, and represent urgent health challenges nationally. The RFA
is open to all faculty, staff, students, and trainees across Duke University and Duke University
Health System.

Applications for the next emerging ideas and innovation funding cycle is now closed and will re-open
in the Fall. Priority is given to ideas that harness the power of AI to proactively solve critical
healthcare challenges, improving operational efficiency and transforming patient care.

[ Learn More ][39]
[ [DIHI RFA 2026-2027 Announcement][DIHI RFA 2026-2027 Announcement] ][40]

Oct 6, 2025             │        │DIHI RFA open for submission          
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
**Nov 7, 2025 11:59 PM**│        │**Application due date**              
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Feb 2026                │        │Finalists – Presentation to leadership
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Apr 2027                │        │Funding start                         
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Nov 2026                │        │Midpoint reporting                    
────────────────────────┴────────┴──────────────────────────────────────

## Our Focus

### [ Innovation Science & Implementation ][41]

Positively impacting clinical care in the real world by putting innovations into practice.

### [ Technology & Innovation Infrastructure ][42]

Increasing the speed to deliver value and expanding the potential for achievable innovation.

### [ Workforce Training & Education ][43]

Expanding the capabilities of the individuals that make innovation possible.

## Featured Projects

representing gleaning data from bacterial growth on agar]

### [ Sepsis Watch™: the implementation of a Duke-specific early warning system for sepsis ][45]

Sepsis Watch is a deep learning model that leverages real-time EHR data to improve detection and
treatment of sepsis in the hospital. It was successfully integrated into routine clinical care in
November 2018 and has reshaped how local machine learning projects are executed.

Create a chest pain assessment tool which integrates with Epic using FHIR to rule-in or rule-out
acute MI.

# Catalyzing Transformative Innovations in Health & Healthcare

The mission of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation (DIHI) is to catalyze transformative
innovations in health and healthcare, and to help cultivate a community of innovation and
entrepreneurship across Duke University and the health enterprise.

[ Learn More About Us ][38]

## Annual Request for Applications

In alignment with the its mission, the Duke Institute for Health Innovation is constantly seeking
out innovations in care delivery. The annual request for applications (RFA) is a mechanism for
designing and implementing innovations to address actual and important problems encountered by care
providers, patients and their loved ones, and represent urgent health challenges nationally. The RFA
is open to all faculty, staff, students, and trainees across Duke University and Duke University
Health System.

Applications for the next emerging ideas and innovation funding cycle is now closed and will re-open
in the Fall. Priority is given to ideas that harness the power of AI to proactively solve critical
healthcare challenges, improving operational efficiency and transforming patient care.

[ Learn More ][39]
[ [DIHI RFA 2026-2027 Announcement][DIHI RFA 2026-2027 Announcement] ][40]

────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Feb 2026                │        │Finalists – Presentation to leadership
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Apr 2027                │        │Funding start                         
────────────────────────┼────────┼──────────────────────────────────────
Nov 2026                │        │Midpoint reporting                    
────────────────────────┴────────┴──────────────────────────────────────

## Our Focus

### [ Innovation Science & Implementation ][41]

Positively impacting clinical care in the real world by putting innovations into practice.

### [ Technology & Innovation Infrastructure ][42]

Increasing the speed to deliver value and expanding the potential for achievable innovation.

### [ Workforce Training & Education ][43]

Expanding the capabilities of the individuals that make innovation possible.

FMOL Health is one of the largest healthcare systems based in Louisiana and is the leading
healthcare provider for more than half of Louisiana's population, as well as serves Mississippi's
largest metropolitan area. The health system is a non-profit, Catholic organization sponsored by the
Franciscan Missionaries of Our Lady. Headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, the ministry serves
patients in Louisiana and Mississippi through a network of hospitals, clinics, physicians, elderly
housing and integrated systems.

powerful, in-workflow platform. We deliver the right data, tools, actions and AI-driven apps at the

Bring the right insights and actions into the clinical moment – no portals, no extra clicks, just

[harbor physicians]

Harbor Physicians provides compassionate primary care and internal medicine for adults in Orange
Park, Florida. We’re accepting new patients—call to verify insurance and schedule your visit.
* Primary Care & Internal Medicine (Adults)
* Annual Physicals & Medicare Wellness Visits
* Chronic condition management (diabetes, blood pressure, cholesterol, thyroid)
* Same-day sick visits (when available)
* In-Office Testing: Flu, COVID, Strep, Urinalysis, Pregnancy
* EKG Services & Care Coordination/Referrals

## Care for Your Everyday Health!

Our Primary Care Services

## Primary Care

Comprehensive primary care for adults, including routine checkups, sick visits, and ongoing health
management.

**Chronic Condition Management**

Personalized care for diabetes, high blood pressure, cholesterol, thyroid disorders, and other
chronic conditions.

## Preventive Care & Wellness Visits

Annual physicals, Medicare wellness visits, routine screenings, and preventive health services.

## Internal Medicine Services

Advanced evaluation and management of complex medical conditions with coordinated specialty
referrals when needed.

###### **Conveniently located in Orange Park, FL and serving patients from nearby communities
###### including Jacksonville, Fleming Island and Middleburg.**

## Our Services & Treatments

At Harbor Physicians, we provide comprehensive primary care and internal medicine services tailored
to adult patients’ needs.

### Chronic Disease Management

We provide ongoing care and monitoring for common chronic conditions to help patients manage their
health and prevent complications.
* Diabetes
* High Blood Pressure
* High Cholesterol
* COPD & Asthma
* Thyroid Problems
* Osteoporosis

### Preventive Care & Screenings

We offer select in-office procedures and treatments to support diagnosis, symptom relief, and
ongoing care.
* Annual Wellness Exams
* Vaccinations & Immunizations
* Cancer Screenings (e.g., breast, colon, and skin cancer)
* Health Risk Assessments

 

### Specialized Treatments & Procedures

Our clinic also offers a variety of specialized treatments and procedures to address specific
medical needs, including:
* Joint Injections for arthritis and joint pain relief
* Erectile Dysfunction Treatment for men’s health concerns
* Skin Tag Removal & Biopsies to address skin conditions
* Birth Control & Gynecological Exams for women’s health
* PAP Smears & Warts Treatment for preventive care

Our team uses the latest techniques and technology to ensure you receive the most effective
treatments with minimal discomfort.

## Our Board-Certified Doctors

Our board-certified doctors are committed to providing the highest level of medical care. Each
doctor brings a wealth of experience and knowledge to the practice, ensuring that you receive the
best possible healthcare.

#### Dr. Muhammad Ismaeel Akhtar MD

Dr. Akhtar is a highly experienced physician specializing in family practice. With a background in
psychiatry, he brings a unique perspective to patient care, offering compassionate and comprehensive
services for both physical and mental well-being.

#### Dr. Omer Ismaeel, MD

Dr. Omer grew up in Orange park, Florida & graduated from Fleming Island High School. He completed
his internal medicine residency at Orange Park Hospital in Florida. He has years of experience as a
hospitalist and primary care physician, specializing in the treatment of a wide range of conditions.
His expertise allows him to manage complex health issues effectively and provide patient-centered
care.

#### Dr. Osman Ismaee

# [Our Services]Healthcare Integration Services for Labs and Hospitals

[ Let's talk about your project ][61]

We help healthcare organizations connect EHR, LIS, PACS, and billing workflows using HL7, FHIR, and
secure APIs. Whether you need new interfaces, modernization, or ongoing support, our team focuses on
reliable data exchange you can maintain.

### What we integrate

Healthcare integrations usually break when standards, vendors, and workflows don’t line up. We help
teams connect the systems and formats they rely on most:
* **[HL7 v2 messaging][62]**: ADT, ORM, ORU, and custom interface workflows
* **[FHIR APIs and SMART on FHIR][63]** use cases
* **[EHR integrations][64]** for clinical and operational data exchange
* **[LIS integrations][65]** for lab orders, results, and outreach connectivity
* **[PACS and imaging workflows (DICOM)][66]** that need reliable routing and access
* **[RCM integrations][67]** for eligibility, claims, remittance, and reporting
* **[Healthcare API development][68]** for secure system-to-system connectivity

Not sure where to start? **[A short discovery call][69]** usually clarifies the best path.

# [Why a Conversation May Be the Highest-ROI Investment a Healthcare CEO Can Make][15]

Posted on [July 14, 2026][16] by [henrykotula][17] • Posted in [Uncategorized][18] • Tagged

## One of the most impactful leadership tools isn’t a new technology, consulting framework, or
## operational initiative. It’s being human. 

Hospital and health system leaders spend countless hours reviewing financial dashboards, quality
metrics, staffing ratios, and strategic plans. **Yet one of the most impactful leadership tools is
much more simple: lunch.**

Yes, as in food and conversation. Specifically in this case, a simple practice called **“Check-ins
with Charles.”**

At our June 2026 **[HealthLeaders CEO Exchange][26]** in Avon, Colorado, some of healthcare’s top
executives gathered for an honest conversation about leadership, culture, financial performance, and
the future of the industry.

During the discussion I moderated, **[Charles Williams, regional president at Baylor Scott &
White][27]**, covered everything from revenue cycle management and physician engagement to CEO
succession planning.

Yet one of the most compelling ideas shared that afternoon (and that had all the other CEOs rapidly
engaging) had nothing to do with technology, reimbursement models, or operational restructuring. It
was Williams’ leadership initiative “Check-ins with Charles.”

**The concept is remarkably simple. **On a regular basis, Williams invites a randomly selected group
of employees—from nurses and environmental services staff to finance professionals and
administrative team members—to an informal Chick-fil-A lunch. There is no PowerPoint presentation.
There are no scripted talking points. There is no formal agenda. The purpose is simply to listen.

As Williams explained during the discussion, the impact has gone far beyond an hour spent sharing a
meal.

“When that email goes out,” he told the group, “it’s not that guy, it’s Charles.”

That distinction may sound small, but in today’s healthcare environment, it represents something
much larger: trust.

Healthcare executives spend enormous amounts of time analyzing financial statements, reviewing
quality metrics, discussing workforce shortages, and developing strategic plans. Those activities
are essential. But as the CEO Exchange conversation repeatedly demonstrated, strategy only succeeds
when people believe in the leaders asking them to execute it.

### **Trust Before Strategy**

Healthcare leaders often focus on execution. We talk about operating margins, revenue cycle
performance, patient experience scores, physician productivity, employee retention, and quality
outcomes.

Those metrics matter, but execution doesn’t begin with dashboards. It begins with trust.

One of the recurring themes throughout the CEO Exchange was that organizations often fail to
communicate proactively because leaders and employees simply don’t know one another well enough.
Everyone is busy. Calendars are full. Meetings dominate the day. **Yet when leaders become
disconnected from the frontline, small problems stay hidden until they become expensive crises.**

Williams described how “Check-ins with Charles” has become one way to **eliminate that disconnect.**

**The informal lunches allow employees to speak openly in a setting where titles disappear. Clinical
and non-clinical staff have an opportunity to ask questions, offer suggestions, and discuss concerns
directly with the CEO.**

He complements those lunches with another simple communication strategy: a monthly three-minute
video message. Sometimes the videos are intentionally lighthearted—wearing a Valentine’s shirt
covered in hearts or joking with employees—to demonstrate vulnerability and approachability.

The objective isn’t entertainment, it’s accessibility, and employees stop seeing “the president” and
begin seeing a person.

**That shift has produced measurable results.**

Williams shared that following these consistent communication efforts, his organization achieved the
highest employee engagement survey participation rate in its history.

succession planning.

engaging) had nothing to do with technology, reimbursement models, or operational restructuring. It
was Williams’ leadership initiative “Check-ins with Charles.”

of employees—from nurses and environmental services staff to finance professionals and
administrative team members—to an informal Chick-fil-A lunch. There is no PowerPoint presentation.

meal.

That distinction may sound small, but in today’s healthcare environment, it represents something
much larger: trust.

quality metrics, discussing workforce shortages, and developing strategic plans. Those activities
are essential. But as the CEO Exchange conversation repeatedly demonstrated, strategy only succeeds
when people believe in the leaders asking them to execute it.

performance, patient experience scores, physician productivity, employee retention, and quality
outcomes.

communicate proactively because leaders and employees simply don’t know one another well enough.

disconnected from the frontline, small problems stay hidden until they become expensive crises.**

Williams described how “Check-ins with Charles” has become one way to **eliminate that disconnect.**

and non-clinical staff have an opportunity to ask questions, offer suggestions, and discuss concerns
directly with the CEO.**

video message. Sometimes the videos are intentionally lighthearted—wearing a Valentine’s shirt
covered in hearts or joking with employees—to demonstrate vulnerability and approachability.

begin seeing a person.

highest employee engagement survey participation rate in its history.

prepared to act on what they hear.

despite coming from a nursing background. Rather than pretending to understand every technical
aspect of billing and coding, she gathered everyone into one room and admitted what she didn’t know.

collaborated.**

exercise, but as a learning opportunity.

conference rooms.

improvements because the hierarchy has temporarily disappeared.

organizational performance.**

priorities, and adapt to another strategic vision.

the expectations of the incoming CEO.

difficult financial periods, replacing leaders before long-term strategies have time to mature.**

Several executives pointed to health systems where senior leaders have remained in place for more
than a decade as examples of how leadership stability creates a competitive advantage.

pipelines.** Potential future presidents and chief operating officers are paired with experienced
mentors well before succession becomes necessary, ensuring continuity and preserving organizational
culture rather than forcing each new leader to reinvent it.

CEO.

small enough for you?”

There was no fear, there was trust.

Not mission statements.

Not values posters hanging in hallways.

Not speeches from the executive suite.

**Culture is built through everyday interactions that convince employees they are seen, heard,
respected, and safe enough to speak honestly.**

### **Leadership That Listens**

Healthcare continues to face unprecedented pressure—from workforce shortages and financial
uncertainty to AI, rising consumer expectations, and increasing regulatory complexity.

No CEO can personally solve every challenge facing a modern health system.

**Every CEO, however, can create an environment where employees feel comfortable identifying
problems early, collaborating across departments, and contributing ideas before issues become
crises.**

That is the real lesson behind “Check-ins with Charles.”

It isn’t really about Chick-fil-A or even about lunch. It is about replacing hierarchy with
humanity.

The conversations in Avon made one thing abundantly clear:** Organizations that invest time in
authentic communication build trust. Trust strengthens culture. Strong cultures execute strategy

# What Awaits You at **#IHSNY27**

The annual Integrative Healthcare Symposium offers a premier educational experience designed for
integrative health professionals and forward-thinking practitioners. The program delivers
comprehensive, evidence-based insights with practical applications you can immediately bring back to
strengthen and validate your practice.

From Medical Doctors and Doctors of Osteopathy to Naturopathic Doctors, Registered Dietitian
Nutritionists, Nurse Practitioners, Registered Nurses, Health Coaches and others, you will gain
access to an exceptional mix of in-depth educational sessions and meaningful networking
opportunities with leaders across the field.

[attendmg]

Source inspiration and fresh ideas, find answers and a supportive, diverse community of like-minded
peers.

[ Attendee Information ][64]

Connect with passionate and educated integrative companies at the forefront of holistic healthcare.

### Important Information

Recently the Integrative Healthcare Symposium has been the target of groups that offer a variety of
fraudulent services. This includes but is not limited to fraudulent travel, advertising and data
services. Many of our customers have reported that these groups who are NOT our official vendors
fail to deliver on their promises to provide hotel reservations, advertising, or accurate data, then
refuse to grant refunds. Some of these groups engage in illegal phishing practices or embed malware
in their messages that could (if clicked) infect/hack your company’s systems. 

**We strongly advise that you do not click on any links from e-mails or groups that look suspicious
and always check our official vendor list  before contracting with anyone.**  If you suspect that
you have been contacted by a fraudulent vendor or have any questions please contact us at
[[email protected]][103]   You can view the list of official vendors for the Integrative Healthcare
Symposium [**here**][104].

Please Note that Integrative Healthcare Symposium and its official vendors **DO NOT** sell attendee
lists under any circumstance. **Companies or Groups offering such lists are not affiliated with the
Integrative Healthcare Symposium in any way and cannot possibly have accurate attendee
data. ****Buyers should BEWARE!**

integrative health professionals and forward-thinking practitioners. The program delivers
comprehensive, evidence-based insights with practical applications you can immediately bring back to
strengthen and validate your practice.

# Helping Hospitals Expedite
# Post Acute Authorizations

 

## **Every patient deserves the right level of care at the right time**

[Request Information][14]

### *What** if**…*

*you could save significant dollars by expediting your post-acute authorizations while decreasing
avoidable inpatient hospital days, length of stay, authorization turnaround time,
and denials? *

### Unlock Your Hospital’s Full Potential with Integrative Healthcare Solutions, LLC

*Assisting hospitals in improving quality of care while reducing cost, we offer comprehensive care
management solutions with a **unique niche in reducing hospital turnaround time for post-acute
authorizations **tailoring our approach to the specialized needs of each client. Proven success in:*

*• Boosting Financial Performance***

*• Enhancing overall hospital throughput **while decreasing ED boarding hours*

*• Saving inpatient hospital days *

*• Reducing unnecessary hospital days*

*• Expediting post-acute authorization turnaround time*

*• Reducing post-acute authorization denials*

*• Improving patient and team member experience*

*• Ensuring compliance with payer requirements and regulations*

*• Decreasing 30-day readmissions*

### ***Why is this work so important?***

Patients who experience discharge delays are at increased risk for hospital-associated
deconditioning, delirium, and hospital-acquired infections. Since inpatient hospital rehabilitation
services are often not equipped to provide daily physical/occupational/speech therapy, delays in
discharge can also deny patients access to needed rehabilitation services (Cai, et al., 2020).
Combined, these factors result in higher mortality and morbidity among patients who are medically
ready yet unable to discharge to the most appropriate level of care in a timely
manner (Rosman et al., 2015).

### Quotes for Care Management Team Members

**

*“Having the post-acute precertification task completed by our centralized Precert Team has given us
back the most precious thing → time.”*

**

*“My Case managers now have more time for increased face-to-face interaction with patients and
families. They are also able to support each other more often.”** *

**

*“I cannot imagine how we would accomplish [everything] on our plates without the pre-certification
team.”** *

**

*“They understand our goals, values and expectations for patient care. It’s reassuring to know that
they are working towards the same goals to reduce avoidable days...”** *

**

*“…the team has been able to share with us the critical language used by the various insurance
companies so that our therapy group is now speaking the same language which has reduced the number
of Peer-to-Peer conversations needed by the physicians.  **AMAZING!!! FAST!!!”***

[Letter of Recommendation for: Adria Grillo-Peck, RN, MS, CMC, President Integrative Healthcare
Solutions, LLC.]

## **Recommendation Letters for:**

## **[Adria Grillo-Peck][15],** *RN, MS, CMC,*

## *President Integrative Healthcare Solutions, LLC.*

I wanted to take this opportunity to endorse and serve as a personal reference for Adria
Grillo-Peck, RN, MS, CMC, President Integrative Healthcare Solutions, LLC. I have had the
opportunity to serve as a direct supervisor to Adria in her previous development in care management
which later resulted in a promotion to Director of Care Management at Miami Valley Hospital, Dayton,
Ohio. Miami Valley Hospital is a charter member of Premier Health. In 2014, Adria transitioned to
the Vice President of Integrated Care Management at Indiana University Health and has held this role
with expanded opportunities for the last decade.

Adria brings an innovative, intellectual, data driven...

***— Click the Button Below for Entire Letter —***

[Jayne Lachey Gmeiner Letter][16]

It is my pleasure to have the opportunity to endorse Adria Grillo-Peck as President, Integrative
Healthcare Solutions, LLC. I have had the pleasure of knowing and working with Adria for several
years. I can confidently say she is extremely dedicated to the mission, promotes innovation and is
results-driven.

Adria brings decades of extensive experience in case management and created a proven track record of
success in planning, implementing, and evaluating initiatives that drove growth and quality; while
consistently focusing on patient experience and safety.

***— Click the Button Below for Entire Letter —***

[Monte Spencer Letter][17]

ready yet unable to discharge to the most appropriate level of care in a timely
manner (Rosman et al., 2015).

## Services we provide

*To see a complete list of services we offer, please *[CLICK HERE][29].

### [ER][30]

Our Emergency Room provides 24/7 rapid, compassionate care for injuries, illnesses, and critical
conditions, ensuring immediate attention when every second matters.

### [Family Practice][31]

Comprehensive family healthcare for all ages, including preventive care, routine checkups, chronic
disease management, and personalized wellness plans to keep families healthy.

### [Radiology][32]

Advanced diagnostic imaging, including X-ray, CT, MRI, mammography, ultrasound, and more, offering
precise, timely results to support accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.

### [Sports Medicine][33]

Specialized care for athletes and active individuals, focusing on injury prevention, rehabilitation,
performance optimization, and safe return to sports activities.

### [Swing Bed Program][34]

Skilled nursing offered in the hospital with rehabilitation services, wound care, IV antibiotics and
more, supporting recovery and regaining independence.

### [Wound Care][35]

Comprehensive wound management using advanced therapies, expert monitoring, and personalized
treatment plans to accelerate healing and prevent complications effectively.

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

Join hundreds of companies of all sizes that are advancing medical technology innovation. Leverage
the network and resources of MDMA to make your voice heard in Washington, DC and beyond!

## Your Trusted Internal Medicine Doctor in Magnolia, TX

Everyone dreams of leading a healthy lifestyle, but inadequate preparation usually stands in the way
of achieving this goal. Taking proactive measures towards health maintenance, such as preventive
care, can help you establish a sustainable way of living. Our goal at the Internal Medicine
Diagnostic Center is to provide Magnolia with the care it deserves. We are proud to offer top-notch
medical services with our expert primary care physician in Magnolia, TX, ready to prevent your
chances of developing health issues.

Preventive Care isn’t only about warning patients about possible health problems. It’s a proactive
approach to healthcare, aiming to stop health issues before they start. We aim to develop a
realistic and practical strategy for you to lead a healthy lifestyle. Our primary care physician in
Magnolia, TX, offers personalized treatment programs to patients and their families because being
unwell is expensive. We will do everything in our power to help you lead a healthy lifestyle and
keep your medical expenses to a minimum.

# Healthcare Integration Free and Open Source No Vendor Lock-In

A community-driven open source engine, fully compatible with Mirth^{®} Connect and extended by a
growing ecosystem of free plugins.

[Download][17]

## Latest news

[See all news →][18]
* [ July 16, 2026
  
  ### Role Based Access Control Plugin Released
  
  An open-source RBAC plugin for Open Integration Engine 4.6.0. Define your own roles with
  per-permission grants and channel-level restrictions, replacing the engine's default always-allow
  authorization controller.
  
  ][19]
* [ July 9, 2026
  
  ### OIE 4.6.0 Released
  
  Open Integration Engine 4.6.0 is now generally available and recommended for production use. It
  moves to a Java 17 minimum, adds editor and CLI conveniences, and remediates 24 CVEs through
  dependency upgrades.
  
  ][20]
* [ June 5, 2026
  
  ### OIE Applies to Join the Eclipse Foundation
  
  OIE has submitted its application to join the Eclipse Foundation, beginning the move to neutral,
  community-owned governance.
  
  ][21]

## Built by the community.

A growing ecosystem of open source plugins extends OIE into the work you actually need to do. Here
are a few.

[See all plugins →][22]
* [ [TLS Manager screenshot] ][23]
  
  ### TLS Manager
  
  Browser-based and in-Administrator certificate management for OIE. Inspect the Java trust store,
  add trusted certificates, and manage local key pairs, with search, validity dates, and
  fingerprints.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][24]
* [ [Cache Manager screenshot] ][25]
  
  ### Cache Manager
  
  In-memory key-value lookups against external databases, with lazy loading, HikariCP pooling, and a
  dedicated admin UI and inspector.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][26]
* [ [Channel & Code Template History screenshot] ][27]
  
  ### Channel & Code Template History
  
  Built-in version history for channels and code templates. Side-by-side diff viewer with word-level
  highlighting, right-click revert, and database-backed storage.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][28]
* [ [Source Code Search screenshot] ][29]
  
  ### Source Code Search
  
  Grep across channel scripts, code templates, global scripts, and message templates, with regex,
  scoping, highlighted matches, and JSON/CSV export.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][30]

## Backed by a real ecosystem.

Companies fund it, build on it, and deliver it to their customers.

# Healthcare Integration Free and Open Source No Vendor Lock-In

A community-driven open source engine, fully compatible with Mirth^{®} Connect and extended by a
growing ecosystem of free plugins.

[Download][17]

## Latest news

[See all news →][18]
* [ July 16, 2026
  
  ### Role Based Access Control Plugin Released
  
  An open-source RBAC plugin for Open Integration Engine 4.6.0. Define your own roles with
  per-permission grants and channel-level restrictions, replacing the engine's default always-allow
  authorization controller.
  
  ][19]
* [ July 9, 2026
  
  ### OIE 4.6.0 Released
  
  Open Integration Engine 4.6.0 is now generally available and recommended for production use. It
  moves to a Java 17 minimum, adds editor and CLI conveniences, and remediates 24 CVEs through
  dependency upgrades.
  
  ][20]
* [ June 5, 2026
  
  ### OIE Applies to Join the Eclipse Foundation
  
  OIE has submitted its application to join the Eclipse Foundation, beginning the move to neutral,
  community-owned governance.
  
  ][21]

## Built by the community.

A growing ecosystem of open source plugins extends OIE into the work you actually need to do. Here
are a few.

[See all plugins →][22]
* [ [TLS Manager screenshot] ][23]
  
  ### TLS Manager
  
  Browser-based and in-Administrator certificate management for OIE. Inspect the Java trust store,
  add trusted certificates, and manage local key pairs, with search, validity dates, and
  fingerprints.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][24]
* [ [Cache Manager screenshot] ][25]
  
  ### Cache Manager
  
  In-memory key-value lookups against external databases, with lazy loading, HikariCP pooling, and a
  dedicated admin UI and inspector.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][26]
* [ [Channel & Code Template History screenshot] ][27]
  
  ### Channel & Code Template History
  
  Built-in version history for channels and code templates. Side-by-side diff viewer with word-level
  highlighting, right-click revert, and database-backed storage.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][28]
* [ [Source Code Search screenshot] ][29]
  
  ### Source Code Search
  
  Grep across channel scripts, code templates, global scripts, and message templates, with regex,
  scoping, highlighted matches, and JSON/CSV export.
  
  [ View on GitHub ][30]

Areas of Focus

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

## Welcome to the Home of Oxford Hoist

We are committed to improving patient and care-giver experiences, placing the well-being of others
at the centre of everything we do.

### People

We acknowledge that people are the heart of all that matters at Oxford – our associates, our
customers and those they care for.

### Passion

We will actively pursue innovative solutions with uncompromising vigour to enable the very best
provision of patient care.

### Performance

We will bring to market high-quality, best-value integrated solutions that address the needs of
today and anticipate those of tomorrow.

# We Serve to **Solve**^{®}

For more than 40 years, PYA has worked alongside health systems, financial institutions, and
businesses across industries, navigating complex financial, regulatory, and operational challenges.
From compliance and revenue integrity to tax strategy and transactions, we bring the deep expertise
and responsive approach our clients count on. 

[ [Play PYA Way Video] ][82]

## [HELP is our culture. Relationships are our passion. ][83]

## The PYA Difference

[PYA Difference - Independence]

### Independence

Private ownership means we answer only to our clients, not to third-party investors, giving us the
freedom to be thorough and thoughtful in our work. We judge our success by our clients’ success.

### Relationships

We value long-term relationships and work hard to maintain them. Our commitment to client
relationships and the communities we serve remains constant.

[PYA Difference - Responsiveness]

### Responsiveness

PYA has a reputation among clients for responsiveness. PYA maintains a Firm policy that we will
respond to calls and emails immediately when possible, but at least within 24 hours.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
Celebrating 170 years
Life Unlimited
Sports Medicine
Ultimate victory

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}

arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced

biocompatible.

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# The right level of care, close to home.

ScionHealth operates a network of long-term acute care hospitals and community hospitals across the
country that deliver high quality, compassionate specialty care for medically complex patients and
essential acute care services for communities.

[ Learn About ScionHealth ][25]
 

## Levels of Care

ScionHealth operates specialty hospitals and community health systems that provide the right level
of care based on each patient's needs.

### Specialty Hospitals

Our specialty hospitals provide advanced long-term acute care and rehabilitation for patients
recovering from serious illnesses, injuries, or complex medical conditions. Through physician-led,
interdisciplinary care teams and personalized treatment plans, we help medically complex patients
regain strength, restore function, and achieve the best possible recovery outcomes.

[ Learn More][26]

### Community Health Systems

Our community health systems include short-term acute care hospitals, physician practices, and
outpatient services that provide high-quality healthcare close to home. Designed to meet the needs
of the communities we serve, our care teams deliver preventive, wellness, and advanced medical
services while supporting healthier outcomes for patients and families at every stage of life.

[ Learn More][27]
 
 

## Serving Communities Across the Country

62We treat some of the nation's most medically complex patients in 62 Specialty Hospitals.

6 We deliver essential acute care through 6 Community Hospitals across 5 markets.

23We serve communities across the country in 23 states.

[ Find a Location ][28]
 
 
 

### Latest from ScionHealth

Accolades

Jun 15, 2026

## [Two ScionHealth Hospitals Named to Becker’s 2026 List of ‘100 Great Community Hospitals’][29]

Two ScionHealth hospitals, Carolina Pines Regional Medical Center in Hartsville, South Carolina, and
St. Francis - Emory Healthcare in Columbus, Georgia, have been named to Becker’s Hospital Review’s
2026 listing of “100 Great Community Hospitals.” The annual list recognizes a select group of
hospitals nationwide for excellence in community-based care. Read more here.

[Read More][30]

News Articles

Jun 10, 2026

## [ScionHealth Announces Executive Leadership Transition][31]

Doug Shirley, who has served as ScionHealth’s Chief Financial Officer since April 2025, has been
appointed Chief Executive Officer. Shirley brings more than 25 years of healthcare leadership
experience, including financial strategy, operational improvement, and enterprise transformation
across public, private, and nonprofit systems.

[Read More][32]

News Articles

Jun 09, 2026

## [National Association of Long Term Hospitals (NALTH) Welcomes ScionHealth as New Member][33]

The National Association of Long Term Hospitals (NALTH) announced that ScionHealth, one of the
nation’s leading providers of long-term acute care (LTACH) hospitals, has joined the association.
ScionHealth’s membership significantly broadens NALTH’s national representation of LTACH hospitals
and strengthens the industry’s unified voice at a time when medically complex patients face
increasing barriers to accessing the specialized care they need.

[Read More][34]

News Articles

Jun 02, 2026

## [ScionHealth Announces Completion of Hospital Transaction with Lifepoint Health][35]

ScionHealth has completed the sale of eight community hospitals to Lifepoint Health, marking a
strategic transition that sharpens the company’s focus on specialty hospital services while
maintaining a select community hospital presence.

[Read More][36]

Accolades

Apr 29, 2026

## [ScionHealth CEO Rob Jay Once Again Included on Becker’s List of Great Leaders in Healthcare][37]

ScionHealth Chief Executive Officer Rob Jay was again included on Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026
list of Great Leaders in Healthcare. According to Becker’s, the Great Leaders list recognizes
executives who “represent the best of the best in healthcare leadership. They are bold, courageous
and deeply committed to their causes.” In recognizing Jay for the second straight year, Becker’s
noted that under his leadership, ScionHealth achieved “its strongest year yet in quality accolades
and business performance in 2025.” Read more about his accomplishments in this role here.

[Read More][38]
