# The right level of care, close to home.

ScionHealth operates a network of long-term acute care hospitals and community hospitals across the
country that deliver high quality, compassionate specialty care for medically complex patients and
essential acute care services for communities.

[ Learn About ScionHealth ][25]
 

## Levels of Care

ScionHealth operates specialty hospitals and community health systems that provide the right level
of care based on each patient's needs.

### Specialty Hospitals

Our specialty hospitals provide advanced long-term acute care and rehabilitation for patients
recovering from serious illnesses, injuries, or complex medical conditions. Through physician-led,
interdisciplinary care teams and personalized treatment plans, we help medically complex patients
regain strength, restore function, and achieve the best possible recovery outcomes.

[ Learn More][26]

### Community Health Systems

Our community health systems include short-term acute care hospitals, physician practices, and
outpatient services that provide high-quality healthcare close to home. Designed to meet the needs
of the communities we serve, our care teams deliver preventive, wellness, and advanced medical
services while supporting healthier outcomes for patients and families at every stage of life.

[ Learn More][27]
 
 

## Serving Communities Across the Country

62We treat some of the nation's most medically complex patients in 62 Specialty Hospitals.

6 We deliver essential acute care through 6 Community Hospitals across 5 markets.

23We serve communities across the country in 23 states.

[ Find a Location ][28]
 
 
 

### Latest from ScionHealth

Accolades

Jun 15, 2026

## [Two ScionHealth Hospitals Named to Becker’s 2026 List of ‘100 Great Community Hospitals’][29]

Two ScionHealth hospitals, Carolina Pines Regional Medical Center in Hartsville, South Carolina, and
St. Francis - Emory Healthcare in Columbus, Georgia, have been named to Becker’s Hospital Review’s
2026 listing of “100 Great Community Hospitals.” The annual list recognizes a select group of
hospitals nationwide for excellence in community-based care. Read more here.

[Read More][30]

News Articles

Jun 10, 2026

## [ScionHealth Announces Executive Leadership Transition][31]

Doug Shirley, who has served as ScionHealth’s Chief Financial Officer since April 2025, has been
appointed Chief Executive Officer. Shirley brings more than 25 years of healthcare leadership
experience, including financial strategy, operational improvement, and enterprise transformation
across public, private, and nonprofit systems.

[Read More][32]

News Articles

Jun 09, 2026

## [National Association of Long Term Hospitals (NALTH) Welcomes ScionHealth as New Member][33]

The National Association of Long Term Hospitals (NALTH) announced that ScionHealth, one of the
nation’s leading providers of long-term acute care (LTACH) hospitals, has joined the association.
ScionHealth’s membership significantly broadens NALTH’s national representation of LTACH hospitals
and strengthens the industry’s unified voice at a time when medically complex patients face
increasing barriers to accessing the specialized care they need.

[Read More][34]

News Articles

Jun 02, 2026

## [ScionHealth Announces Completion of Hospital Transaction with Lifepoint Health][35]

ScionHealth has completed the sale of eight community hospitals to Lifepoint Health, marking a
strategic transition that sharpens the company’s focus on specialty hospital services while
maintaining a select community hospital presence.

[Read More][36]

Accolades

Apr 29, 2026

## [ScionHealth CEO Rob Jay Once Again Included on Becker’s List of Great Leaders in Healthcare][37]

ScionHealth Chief Executive Officer Rob Jay was again included on Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026
list of Great Leaders in Healthcare. According to Becker’s, the Great Leaders list recognizes
executives who “represent the best of the best in healthcare leadership. They are bold, courageous
and deeply committed to their causes.” In recognizing Jay for the second straight year, Becker’s
noted that under his leadership, ScionHealth achieved “its strongest year yet in quality accolades
and business performance in 2025.” Read more about his accomplishments in this role here.

[Read More][38]

News Articles

The West Bengal Health Department has taken a major step toward improving outpatient services,

OPD services are designed for patients who require medical consultations but do not need hospital
admission. Whether you need a routine check-up or treatment for a specific health issue, this system
allows you to schedule your visit in advance. The online booking option is especially helpful for
elderly patients who require regular medical care, ensuring they receive timely treatment without
facing long queues or unnecessary trouble.

### SSKM Hospital Online Ticket Booking at HMIS.WBHealth.gov.in

Booking an OPD appointment at SSKM Hospital has become easier with the online system introduced by
the West Bengal Health Department. Now, you can schedule your visit from home without waiting in
long lines. Follow this simple step-by-step guide to book your appointment online:
1.  **Visit the Official Website** – Open your browser and go to the West Bengal Health Department’s
    online booking portal: [onlinehmis.wbhealth.gov.in][17].
2.  **Enter Your Mobile Number** – On the homepage, you’ll see a welcome message. Provide your
    mobile number to receive a one-time password (OTP).
3.  **Verify Your Number** – Enter the OTP sent to your phone and click “Submit” to proceed.
4.  **Select Your Appointment Date** – Choose a suitable date for your hospital visit from the
    available options.
5.  **Fill in Your Personal Details** – Enter your full name, gender, contact number, age, country,
    state, and district.
6.  **Provide Your Address** – Fill in your complete address along with a four-digit PIN code.
7.  **Choose the Department** – Select the medical department relevant to your consultation.
8.  **Get Doctor and Room Details** – Once you submit the form, the system will display the doctor’s
    name and room number assigned to you.
9.  **Download and Print Your Token** – Save the generated token in PDF format and take a printout
    for future reference.
10. **Visit the Hospital on Your Appointment Day** – Carry your printed token to the hospital for a
    hassle-free consultation.

By following these steps, you can easily book your OPD appointment at SSKM Hospital, ensuring timely
and smooth access to medical care without unnecessary delays.

## WB Health Appointment Registration

Residents of West Bengal can now easily book health appointments online without any hassle. This
digital service makes it possible to schedule a consultation without visiting the hospital
beforehand, saving both time and effort. Follow these simple steps to book your appointment:
1. **Visit the Official Website** – Open your browser and go to the West Bengal Health Department’s
   online registration portal: [onlinehmis.wbhealth.gov.in][18].
2. **Find the Appointment Booking Section** – On the homepage, look for the appointment registration
   option and click on it.
3. **Log In or Sign Up** – If you are a first-time user, create an account by providing basic
   details. If you already have an account, log in using your credentials.
4. **Select the Type of Consultation** – Choose the kind of appointment you need, whether it’s a
   general health check-up or a specialist consultation.
5. **Enter Your Personal Details** – Fill in your name, contact number, and address as required.
6. **Pick a Date and Time** – Select a suitable date and time from the available slots.
7. **Review Your Information** – Double-check all the details you entered to make sure everything is
   correct.
8. **Confirm Your Booking** – Submit your appointment request, and you will receive a confirmation
   message on your registered mobile number or email.
9. **Save or Print the Confirmation** – Keep a copy of your appointment details and carry it with
   you when you visit the hospital.

By following these steps, you can quickly and easily book your WB Health appointment online,
ensuring timely medical care without any unnecessary waiting.

Zenitel - A global provider of

### Intelligent critical communication solutions

Zenitel is a leading provider of Intelligent Critical Communication Solutions, enabling everyone to
hear, be heard and be understood, every time and everywhere.

Our primary system offering is within Intercom, Public Address, Voice Alarm, IP speakers and Radio.
With our Zenitel brand, we are recognized globally for offering advanced and reliable onshore and
offshore communication systems. Our offering includes products based on Vingtor, Stentofon, Zenitel,
Phontech, and ASL technology.

## Business Units

From our 3 business units we serve all segments with reliable communication solutions where life,
property and assets are at stake.

[Safety and Security ][161]

Corporate and Public, Education, Smart City, Prisons, Retail, Healthcare, and Industrial

Ensure the safety of people and security of buildings with intelligent audio solutions.

[Maritime & Energy Solutions ][162]

Cruise vessels, workboats, fishing vessels, offshore wind, floaters, oil rigs and more

We’re specialists in the maritime and energy segments: we know the ocean industry, and we speak your
language.

[Transportation Solutions ][163]

Rail Infrastructure, Rolling Stock, Highways, Road Tunnels, Airports, Ports

Communication solutions across a range of sectors, offering systems that not only protect but engage
and perform.

Our mission is to keep people safe by enabling everyone

With every Zenitel product and solution we develop, we apply our **vision to be the world-leading
provider of intelligent critical-communication solutions.**

From our position as a technology leader and the expert in audio, we continuously work to be the
most professional, competent, innovative and trustworthy provider for security and safety
applications, always going the extra mile to develop ourselves and our partners to meet and exceed
the end customers’ needs.

that meets the desired security standards, as well as expectations of our customers, have gained
Zenitel broad market recognition over the years.

#### Open platforms & Integrations

Zenitel offers a wide variety of integrated communication solutions, which enable you to add audio

#### Truly a Technology Company

Zenitel - A global provider of

### Intelligent critical communication solutions

Zenitel is a leading provider of Intelligent Critical Communication Solutions, enabling everyone to
hear, be heard and be understood, every time and everywhere.

Our primary system offering is within Intercom, Public Address, Voice Alarm, IP speakers and Radio.
With our Zenitel brand, we are recognized globally for offering advanced and reliable onshore and
offshore communication systems. Our offering includes products based on Vingtor, Stentofon, Zenitel,
Phontech, and ASL technology.

## Business Units

From our 3 business units we serve all segments with reliable communication solutions where life,
property and assets are at stake.

[Safety and Security ][161]

Corporate and Public, Education, Smart City, Prisons, Retail, Healthcare, and Industrial

Ensure the safety of people and security of buildings with intelligent audio solutions.

[Maritime & Energy Solutions ][162]

Cruise vessels, workboats, fishing vessels, offshore wind, floaters, oil rigs and more

We’re specialists in the maritime and energy segments: we know the ocean industry, and we speak your
language.

[Transportation Solutions ][163]

Rail Infrastructure, Rolling Stock, Highways, Road Tunnels, Airports, Ports

Communication solutions across a range of sectors, offering systems that not only protect but engage
and perform.
